# Lady player pulse and terminal monitor

Benboncan's real human stethoscope recording is retained in
`../RecordedHorror/sources/heart.mp3`. Its two physical contacts are shortened
into a 320 ms pair; the runtime changes spacing from 58 to 168 BPM while keeping
pitch constant. Fade-in and proximity gain keep the initial beat faint.

`sources/monitor-unhissed.mp3` is the public high-quality preview of Benboncan's
[Steady Heart Monitor To Flatline Unhissed](https://freesound.org/people/Benboncan/sounds/63832/).
The author built it from a beep recorded in a hospital and removed hiss with
Izotope RX. The original 61792 candidate is retained beside it. `selection.json`
compares quiet-window floors and sustained-tone levels, records exact trims,
source hashes and edits. The selected excerpt is a real recording-derived
710 Hz medical tone, not an oscillator generated by this project. The terminal cue now lasts exactly 3.0 seconds: zero-phase fourth-order 580–900 Hz filtering on surrounding source context removes harsh harmonics before the 142–145s trim; 12/90ms edge fades avoid clicks. `selection.json` retains the rendered duration/edge/spectral comparison.

All three source recordings are Benboncan, CC BY 4.0. The full license is in
`CC-BY-4.0.txt`; game attribution is in `../Audio-Credits.txt`.

Reproduce offline with Python 3.11, numpy 1.26.4, scipy 1.14.1 and soundfile 0.13.1:

```
python HappyToyV2/SourceArt/Audio/render_lady_heartbeat.py
```

`--download` refreshes the public monitor previews and license from the recorded
source pages. It is optional; all necessary input audio is committed. Automated
Unity checks use a muted process session and inspect pre-device PCM, without
claiming a human listening review.
